correctness.rationale: The finite-type definition and invertible lag recurrence give exactly k^m fibers over the golden-mean shift; finite-to-one entropy invariance yields log(phi). An explicit primitive finite graph is obtained by isolated residue-targeting pulses. For n dividing m every ambient n-periodic point is admitted, while for n not dividing m there is a forbidden periodic witness: a single spike for k>=3, or two consistent parity equations forcing adjacent 1s for k=2. The lcm cutoff follows by divisibility and zeta-log formal series. Exhaustive finite tests confirm small parameters but are not the infinite proof.
